description: Harvest's fUSDC and fUSDT vaults computed share-price from Curve y-pool's instant exchange rate. Attacker flash-loaned, swapped to skew the y-pool spot price, deposited into Harvest at the deflated price (receiving extra shares), swapped back to restore the pool, and withdrew at the restored price for a profit. ~32 nested deposit/withdraw cycles drained the vaults. Canonical flash-loan-on-spot-price example.
